faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XJ 3.0 V6 use?
faqLeft.a: The XJ 3.0 V6 Supercharged uses the AJ126 - a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol engine, fitted from 2013 to 2019 across the X351 generation.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XJ 3.0 V6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XJ 3.0 V6?
faqLeft.a: The XJ 3.0 V6 uses the AJ126. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ126 XJ 3.0 V6 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We rebuild the AJ126 to original specification, replacing worn components as part of the process.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XJ 3.0 V6 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XJ if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XJ 3.0 V6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XJ owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
